}}'''Derry''' was a [[Redarm]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Derry}}

== Activities ==
After the Band sets up camp a league outside [[Caemlyn]], Derry was captured by the ''[[gholam]]'', interrogated and then murdered.

==Trivia==
*Derry is named after Joel Derby, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
